normalized_matching_profile.description: Description 30A ESCAPES presents… “Aqua Waters,” your perfect Seacrest Beach retreat! Relax in this large luxury escape featuring 5 suites, access to the incredible lagoon pool directly out the back door, and 7 bikes to explore 30A. The 3rd-floor balcony steals the show with cozy porch swings for endless fun. Pet-friendly, spacious, and just a short stroll to the beach, shops, and dining, “Aqua Waters” is designed for unforgettable memories. Learn more below…*** HIGHLIGHTS ***12,000 sq. ft. Lagoon Pool Right Outside the Back Door: Step out and dive into the aqua waters!Expansive 3 rd-Floor Balcony: Kick back on the oversized balcony with swings, and a TV—a great hangout for all.5 Suites: Each of the 3 King, 1 Queen and 1 Bunk Room has a dedicated bathroom and unique features to accommodate everyone with ease.Professional Grilling Space featuring BIG GREEN EGG and Sink.Pet-Friendly: Bring your furry friend! Pets are welcome with approval and a fee.2-Min Walk to Boutique Shops, Dining at at Peddlers Pavilion in Seacrest community.Seasonal Tram Service to the Beach: Take the tram for convenient seasonal beach access, which is just a 7-minute walk away.7 Bikes for Exploring: Explore the scenic 30A area with adult beach bikes included.Rosemary & Alys Proximity: Within a short distance to the iconic neighboring communities and their stunning beaches.Eager to Read More? Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:“Perfect location, spacious rooms, and our family loved the 3rd-floor deck by the pool.” – Joshua G.“Everything about this property was PERFECT! A clean and wonderful home close to the best beach spots!” – Michael D.“Our teens loved riding bikes, playing ping pong, and relaxing at the beach. Great for families!” – Susan B.*** LIVING AREAS ***Relax in the open-concept living space with beach-inspired decor, hardwood floors, and natural sunlight. The plush sectional and cozy armchairs make it the perfect spot to unwind, while large windows offer views of the iconic lagoon pool.Spacious sectional sofa and armchairsLarge smart TVDirect access to the back patio overlooking the lagoon pool*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Cook up delicious meals in the fully equipped gourmet chef’s kitchen featuring high-end appliances, ample counter space, and a custom dining table. A Large kitchen island with additional bar seating makes it easy to gather for meals or drinks.Fully equipped gourmet kitchen & kitchen barCustom dining table for 8 + bar seating for 4Outdoor grilling area with ample counter space, BIG GREEN EGG and sink setup*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***1st-floor Patio with Direct Pool AccessStep outside the back door and take advantage of direct access to the 12,000 square feet Lagoon Pool. Perfect for cooling off on a hot summer day or soaking up the Florida sunshine, the patio makes it easy to dive straight into vacation mode.Front porch with outdoor seatingGrilling Prep SpaceDirect Lagoon Pool access3rd-Floor BalconyThe expansive 3rd-floor balcony is the ultimate hangout spot. Relax on the porch swings, enjoy the wet bar and TV for evening entertainment. It’s the perfect space to unwind and enjoy the views.Gorgeous pool views from 3rd-floor balcony2 Large Bed SwingsWet barSmart TVSun loungers and Outdoor furnitureDining area for 6*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:Queen Bedroom: Flat-screen TV and dedicated bathroom with glass-enclosed shower2nd Floor:Primary Suite 1: King bed, private balcony with lagoon views, flat-screen TV, en suite with garden tub, glass shower, double vanity, and large walk-in closetPrimary Suite 2: King bed, flat-screen TV, closet, en suite with single vanity, glass shower, and large walk-in closetBunk Room: 3 Twin-over-Twin bunk beds, EACH with a Personal TV+, custom built-in closet, and en suite with double vanities and shower/tub combo3rd Floor:Primary Suite 3: King bed, built-in Twin-over-Twin bunk bed, large walk-in closet, flat-screen TV, balcony access, en suite with garden tub, glass shower, and double vanity*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY AMENITIES ***Nestled in the vibrant Seacrest Beach community between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, "Aqua Waters" is a charming retreat that perfectly blends relaxation and convenience. With included bikes, exploring nearby attractions is a breeze.Lagoon Pool – A 12,000 sq. ft. paradise Directly Out the Back Door, featuring a zero-entry splash zone, waterfalls, and plenty of loungers.Beach Access – Seasonal tram service makes getting to the beach easy, perfect for carrying your gear.Peddler’s Pavilion – A quick 2-minute walk to boutique shops, live music, dining, and seasonal nightlife.Rosemary Beach – Only a 10-minute walk to this scenic coastal destination.Alys Beach – Just a 9-minute walk for picturesque views and charming experiences.Scenic Walking & Nature Trails – Explore beautiful trails just steps away.Bike-Friendly Community – Enjoy the included bikes for easy access to nearby spots.Outdoor Amenities – Relax with outdoor seating, loungers, picnic tables, and a grill station.South Walton’s Tallest Sand Dunes – A unique natural feature of this stunning area.*** PET POLICY ***To ensure a clean and enjoyable experience for all guests, please note the following guidelines for pets:Pets are not allowed on furniture, beds, or in the pool.Dogs must be kept in a crate when guests are not present with them.A non-refundable pet fee of $250 + tax applies.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independently.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.This property has 7 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes, a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.There are active Ring doorbell cameras on the front and back patios.Pet-friendly with a non-refundable pet fee of $250 + tax. *** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 92252STRO #: STR-092252
